description: Fix the blank WhatsApp/social OG preview image for custom short links (BUG #1). Root cause: defaultSeoConfig() in api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts sets cfg.defaultOgImage to `${SITE_ORIGIN}/assets/og-default.png`, a static file that does NOT exist on the server (returns the SPA HTML fallback, not an image), so buildCustomShareHtml's fallback and the JSON-LD logo/image point at a 404. Fix by adding a dynamic default-branding OG image endpoint GET /api/og/image/default that reuses the EXISTING branded-logo-card render path (services/og.ts getOrRenderOg with imageUrl:null, identical to how /image/page/:slug works), then repoint cfg.defaultOgImage to `${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/default`. Independent of FEAT-002. MUST NOT change product OG behavior (routes/og.ts /image/product/:id and ogShare.ts buildProductShareHtml are untouched) or the human smart-redirect in routes/link.ts.
steps: In api-node/src/routes/og.ts, add a new route `GET /image/default` beside the other /image/* handlers. Import loadSeoConfig from '../services/ogShare' (getOrRenderOg is already imported from '../services/og'). Handler: `const cfg = await loadSeoConfig(); const img = await getOrRenderOg('default', { title: cfg.business.name || '4A Store', subtitle: '4A Store', imageUrl: null });` then set headers exactly like /image/page/:slug: `res.setHeader('Content-Type', img.contentType); res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=86400'); res.setHeader('Content-Length', String(img.buffer.length)); return res.end(img.buffer);`. Do not add auth — the og routes are public crawler endpoints.
In api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts, change the top import from `import { SITE_ORIGIN } from './origin';` to `import { SITE_ORIGIN, API_ORIGIN } from './origin';`.

In api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts defaultSeoConfig(), change `defaultOgImage: `${SITE_ORIGIN}/assets/og-default.png`,` to ``defaultOgImage: `${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/default`,``. Leave mergeSeoConfig untouched so an admin-saved defaultOgImage override still wins.

Add a pure unit test file api-node/src/__tests__/defaultOgImage.test.ts using node:test + node:assert/strict: import { defaultSeoConfig } from '../seo/localSeo' and { API_ORIGIN } from '../seo/origin'; assert defaultSeoConfig().defaultOgImage === `${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/default`; assert it does NOT include '/assets/og-default.png'. Follow the DB-free style of src/__tests__/shortlinkOg.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: api-node/src/seo/localSeo.ts no longer references '/assets/og-default.png'; defaultSeoConfig().defaultOgImage equals `${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/default`.
api-node/src/routes/og.ts exposes GET /image/default that renders the branded 4A Store logo card via the existing getOrRenderOg path (imageUrl:null).
Running `cd api-node && npm test` passes ALL tests including the new defaultOgImage test.
No changes to /image/product/:id, buildProductShareHtml, or routes/link.ts behavior.
verification: cd api-node && npm run build  (tsc clean, no new errors)
cd api-node && npm test  (all tests pass, including the new defaultOgImage.test.ts)
findings: DONE. New public route: GET /api/og/image/default (defined as router.get('/image/default') in api-node/src/routes/og.ts, mounted at /api/og). It reuses the existing getOrRenderOg('default', { title: cfg.business.name||'4A Store', subtitle:'4A Store', imageUrl:null }) logo-card path, identical headers to /image/page/:slug. loadSeoConfig is imported from '../services/ogShare' (NOTE: loadSeoConfig lives in services/ogShare.ts, not services/og.ts). localSeo.ts now imports API_ORIGIN and defaultSeoConfig().defaultOgImage = `${API_ORIGIN}/og/image/default` (resolves to https://4astore.com/api/og/image/default). mergeSeoConfig left untouched so an admin-saved defaultOgImage still overrides. New pure test: api-node/src/__tests__/defaultOgImage.test.ts (2 tests). npm test is fully green: 76/76 pass (74 prior + 2 new). IMPORTANT for later steps: `npm run build` (tsc) currently FAILS with 3 PRE-EXISTING, OUT-OF-SCOPE errors from a concurrent task in api-node/src/routes/admin.ts:217 and api-node/src/routes/catalog.ts:77,84 — Prisma client lacks the `status` (publish) column on Product. These were confirmed present on the clean baseline (git stash) BEFORE my change; none reference og.ts/localSeo.ts/defaultOgImage.test.ts. They need a `prisma generate` / the publish-status migration from that other task, which is outside FEAT-001 scope and the NO-migrate constraint. My files compile clean and the test loader (register.mjs, per-file transpile) runs without them.
